'''Celanon''' was an important [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and was the [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==Description==
[[File:Nalroni-AE.png|thumb|left|125px|A [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]].]]
Celanon had six continents: [[Cekbar]], [[Arradi]], [[Holvi]], [[Jelldar]], [[Runnor]] and [[Desetur]].<ref name="PoG1" /><ref name="TSWPC" /> The planet was an important trade world, comparable to [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]] and [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Ellorrs Madak}}</ref> The [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] was named [[Celanon City]]. Celanon was also known for its agriculture.<ref name="PoG1" /><ref name="TSWPC" />

The world was known for its multicolored sky due to its advertising screens, which were compared with those of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Ixtlar/Legends|Ixtlar]], and the average [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] world.<ref name="HSATCCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[Celanon Merchant Guild Medical Facility]] was the main hospital of the starport located in the capital city.<ref name="ND">[[No Disintegrations (West End Games)|''No Disintegrations'']]</ref> The local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] force was known as the [[Celanon Organized Protectorate]].<ref name="TRP" />

==History==
{{Quote|&hellip;as for the Celanon campaign, Darth Marr is coordinating the joint armada with minimal losses.|Moff Pyron|<ref name="SoR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], Celanon was controlled by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. It was later part of [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. Celanon was in [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] space during the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was the site of the [[Celanon campaign]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SoR" />

As the Republic's influence in the Outer Rim Territories declined in the millennium after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]], Celanon became an important regional power broker: at the crossroads of the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], it became a prosperous, populous port and attracted investment.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The planet was an important [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] stronghold during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As a result, it became a target for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] theater of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. After the war, Celanon, along with Serenno, begun funding [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] close by.<ref name="TEGTW" />

During [[Operation Strike Fear]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Gafra]]'' transferred a new [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear]] warhead from Celanon to a deep space transfer zone where it was intercepted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Herald (Lambda-class)|''Herald'']].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Celanon was under control of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. The Empire managed to keep control of the world in the years following the death of Zsinj but [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] eventually lost the planet and his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']], at the [[Battle of Celanon]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet [[Battle of the Celanon system|fell]] into the hands of the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]]. Yuuzhan Vong and [[Peace Brigade]] collaborators traveled through the system to attack the [[Jedi Praxeum]] at [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. Remaining part of the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] until the Yuuzhan Vong's surrender to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], Celanon was located in Alliance space as of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. The world was situated in the territory of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] in [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
